email.subject: Shoreline Pros Dentistry: quick site fix ideas
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I looked at the Shoreline Pros Dentistry site. Two things are likely costing you patients: there's no way to book an appointment online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next dentist, and the site isn't mobile-friendly, which is how most people find a dentist in the first place. On top of that, there are no reviews shown, the footer has outdated info, and the page title doesn't say what you do or where.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd change. Worth a quick call?

Alex
Northlight Web
